name: sigma_hunt
description: Run a Sigma ruleset over event logs with whichever engine the host has (Zircolite or Hayabusa) and return normalised detections: rule, level, time, event id, channel and the matching record. A detection is a hypothesis; the record it points at is the evidence.

path.description: An .evtx file or a directory of them

rules.description: A ruleset file or directory; the engine's bundled rules are used when omitted

min_level.description: informational, low, medium, high or critical (default medium)

out_dir.description: Where the engine's own output is kept, under work/
